tools.name: submit_backtest
tools.description: Submits a strategy for backtesting against historical OHLCV data. Returns immediately with an id and status — call get_backtest_result to fetch the outcome once it finishes. Testing the same strategy against many assets? Use submit_backtest_batch instead — one call per asset here adds up fast.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "submit_confirmation_source" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
